summary: This sponsored-style feature from The Independent presents The White Company's Christmas collection, organised around themes such as welcoming guests, celebrating, quiet moments, new rituals, Christmas Day and the days between Christmas and New Year. It picks out decorations, scents, glassware, advent calendars, clothing, bedding, a pre-lit tree and gifts, many described as affordable gifts or stocking fillers.
one_line: The Independent highlights The White Company's Christmas range of decorations, scents, homeware, cosy clothing and gifts, grouped by festive themes.
key_facts: The White Company's Christmas collection is described as available now, with products for cosy homes and affordable gifts.
The pinecone wreath is made from a mixture of faux greenery, pinecones and berries and can hang on a front door, interior wall or table.
The Winter Collection scent features cinnamon, clove and orange and comes as candles, diffusers or oils.
The Nordic Woods Collection has notes of birchwood, amber and eucalyptus.
The Barton Serving Tray has a silver-tone finish and is made of high-quality aluminium crafted in India.
The Snowy Advent Calendar is a penguin with 25 numbered pockets made from velboa faux fur.
A second Advent Calendar has 25 drawers containing candles, shower gels, nail creams and other seasonal scents and wellness goodies.
The Cashmere Bed Socks are made from pure GCS-certified yarns and come in a range of colours.
The Pre Lit Grand Spruce Christmas Tree stands 7.5ft tall and has in-built lights with various lighting settings.
The Jingles Reindeer Comforter from The Little White Company is made from recycled fibres with a red nose and felt antlers.
The Scent Stories Hamper comes in a hand-woven basket with candles, hand wash and diffusers, with scents of myrrh, fir tree and Nordic wood.
The Down Filled Oversized Puffer Coat is made from recycled fibres and has a detachable hood.
The Champagne Trug is hand-soldered in nickel-plated stainless steel and is filled with ice to chill Champagne.
